name: @diaryx/leaf
description: Framework-agnostic rich-text editor for the web: a proportional WYSIWYG surface over leaf-core's caret model, compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'),w=require('./pkg/package.json');if(w.version!==p.version)throw new Error('pkg/ is leaf-wasm '+w.version+', not '+p.version+' - run npm run build:wasm')" && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
